svg.aria-label: Level diagram of the cubesat downlink: 33.0 dBm leaves the transmitter, free-space path loss of 160.0 dB takes it to -127.0 dBm, and the 20 dBi dish raises it to -107.0 dBm, 14 dB above the -121 dBm noise floor; without the dish the signal sits 6 dB under the noise
